objective: Define durable correction, confirmation, pause, and resume semantics for mixed-initiative oracle interaction.
assumptions: A decision packet has a stable identity and revision
A correction can supersede an unexecuted recommendation
unknowns: Human response latency and correction frequency require later observation
invariants: A correction supersedes the prior recommendation before execution
A confirmation records the packet revision it approves
Resume preserves the original decision context and response history
acceptance_predicates: A corrected packet cannot execute under its old revision
A paused packet can resume only with its identity and context
A confirmation and correction are distinguishable records
